summary: Platform shows good architectural separation but faces significant challenges with VB6 legacy system modernization. Critical risks around data migration, authentication, and COM dependency management.

hotspots.reason: Legacy VB6 application with hardcoded database paths, potential SQL injection vulnerabilities, and COM dependencies
Microsoft Access database with potential scalability and security limitations

provenance.evidence: Jet OLEDB provider indicates Access database

hotspots.reason: High coupling between agents without clear error handling or circuit breaker patterns

risks.title: VB6 COM Dependency Hell
risks.description: VB6 application relies on 12+ COM objects that may not be available in modern environments or cloud deployments

risks.title: Hardcoded Database Paths
risks.description: Database connection strings contain absolute file paths that will break in different environments

risks.title: No Authentication Framework
risks.description: VB6 banking application appears to have basic login forms but no modern authentication/authorization framework

risks.title: Data Migration Complexity
risks.description: Migration from Access database to modern system requires careful schema mapping and data validation
